title: Plan a Splunk Upgrade and Validate Prerequisites
objectives: Plan a Splunk Upgrade and Validate Prerequisites
Verify actual source, version, service/data and retained recovery evidence.

tasks.instruction: Open Enterprise upgrade and recovery. Inspect the initial blocked preflight and the actual LM, CM, search-head and indexer topology. The patch target is the explicit 9.4.2 teaching descriptor, not a current real-vendor release recommendation. Plan lm01 → cm01 → sh01 → idx01 → idx02 → idx03; the recorded cluster must remain healthy.

Stage the verified teaching package and create and verify a current configuration-only archive on each of those six hosts. In KV Store independently back up sh01 data; configuration archives do not include it. Review SHA-256 identity, available modeled storage, native syntax, running services and replication/search factors. Capture a fresh valid six-host preflight. Do not start the upgrade in this planning lesson.

Search index=source_logs | stats count and open Job Inspector; count=3. Compare the current native source and archive identities with the retained preflight. A stale or merely once-valid preflight must not complete the lesson.

hints: Inspect the active native source and the original failure before changing anything.
Use the paused shared clock and an independent Search/Job Inspector check.

references.purpose: Controlled upgrade order, artifact verification and health prerequisites

checks.label: Current valid six-host plan and verified independent backups
Verification search and Job Inspector retained

feedback.success: Actual maintenance outcomes, preserved data and independent verification meet this lesson.
feedback.incomplete: Review current source, version, activation history and independent evidence.
